name: CORE Career Suggestion Bank
source_credit: Job information is adapted from O*NET 31.0 (U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration), used under the CC BY 4.0 licence, and from BLS OEWS May 2025 and international occupational prestige data.
notes: Families appear in bank order within each curiosity (bank_order) when nothing in the student's answers distinguishes them.
Route tags: structure Set out/Open/Mixed; focus Deep/Broad/Mixed; team Together/Own/Mixed; setting Steady/Changing/Mixed; 'No data' never matches.
Arabic names (family_ar, study_fields_ar, job_ar) are complete and founder-reviewed (17 Oct 2026).
changing_work = true marks jobs shown with the 'changing work' marker and block S4-CHANGING (see Specification 6.7).
Tags and motivators use a frozen yardstick: cut-offs from the O*NET records in the 3 Oct 2026 bank (bank v1.0), so editing one job never changes another.
